dae52c90c56e76fa06c4d7b37a117469a63cc505: A screen, flow, component, or use case that uses an entity, a data model, or a component (in C4, properties.description and technology describe the relationship). An action uses the data it creates, changes, or reads (properties.mode: create, update, or read); a screen uses the action, integration, or flow supplying a block of its content; a flow uses the screens and actions its steps pass through; an API design uses the entities of its schemas (x-pai-entity) and the components implementing its operations (x-pai-component), relationships it derives when saved.
3aafd9713a107e09bef2b2d91ccbc484e723830e: - API designs: to show the reference of a project API design use an api block {id, type: api, apiDesignRef, revision?}; apiDesignRef is the design id (api_design_list) and revision pins the one shown (without it, the current one). It draws the reference read-only, never a copy of the document; someone who cannot see the design, such as a client with a staff-only one, sees «No disponible».
